card.name: Words after grip, hold, hand, body-part verbs
card.fires_on: Small words (her, to, the, their, fast) right after a verb of gripping, holding or squeezing, or after hand or arm, where a body part or held thing comes next.

modes.label: After grip/hold/squeeze
modes.description: A possessive or article following a verb of holding, gripping or squeezing, before a body part or breath.
modes.example: hold<< their>> breath for 4 to 5 seconds

modes.label: After hand or arm
modes.description: A linking word following a body-part noun in movement descriptions.
modes.example: leading the hand<< to>> whisk away a fly

card.plain: It fires on little words right after verbs like grip or hold, or after hand, just before the body part is named.
